entities.summary: David Fischer is an American former professional ice hockey defenseman who is an assistant coach with EC KAC's affiliate club, KAC Future Team of the Alps Hockey League (AlpsHL). He was selected in the first round, 20th overall, by the Montreal Canadiens in the 2006 NHL Entry Draft.
